signin.tagline: Pull FBX and dependencies from a GitHub branch
signin.title: Sign in to GitHub
signin.desc: The app only needs read access to repository contents. Tokens are encrypted with the system keychain.
signin.ghCliSub: Uses GitHub CLI (gh). If gh is signed out, you approve in the browser with a one-time code.
signin.sso: Org uses SAML SSO? Authorize the token for the organisation when GitHub asks.
signin.ghCodeHint: Enter this code on GitHub to sign in gh:
signin.ghCopied: Code copied to the clipboard — paste it on GitHub.
signin.ghWaiting: Waiting for you to approve in the browser…
signin.step1: Click “Open GitHub”. Use the browser where you are already signed in to GitHub if you can.
signin.step2: Paste the code (⌘V / Ctrl+V) and click Continue, then Authorize.
signin.step3: If GitHub emails you a verification code, open that email and enter the code on GitHub. This happens once per browser.
signin.step4: Come back here — the app continues by itself. No terminal or SSH key needed.
signin.ghMissingTitle: GitHub CLI is not installed on this computer
signin.ghMissingBody: Asset Hub can download the official GitHub CLI (about 15 MB) into its own folder. No admin rights or Terminal needed.
